node.statement: The group-laws external merely calls u_grp the inverse of an unspecified polar map; it does not assert the same source, target, formula Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H, a companion h, or the two inverse identities required in the preceding step. The allowed definitions explicitly provide only partial notation and no such theorem. Therefore the required antecedent for uniqueness is absent, so 1.7.5 cannot identify u_grp=u_pol or transport the group-law conclusions to the root-bound u_pol.
